zh: 马灯快灭了。去商店修一修

zh: 它留着听过的每一个声音。

zh: 山坡上那栋房子。门廊的灯亮着。

keys: Somebody left it on for us.
We know the way home now.
zh: 现在，我们认得回家的路了。

keys: ...a house... a light in the window...
For one frame: a lit window.
zh: 只有一帧：一扇亮着灯的窗。

keys: That's enough. We know the way now.

keys: It looks just like the tape.

zh: 每个区域背景里的机器、风和火的声音。

keys: Steam hammer: stand on a bench or the desk to reach it
zh: 蒸汽锤：站上长凳或桌子就打得到它

keys: Find the house from the tape. Up and to the right.
zh: 去录像里那栋房子：往上，往右。

zh: 从已经打到过的关卡开始。

keys: Flutters toward light. Hit it before it dives.
zh: 会朝亮光扑过来，在它俯冲前打掉。

keys: Hops at you. Watch the red mark where it lands.
zh: 朝你跳过来，看地上的红色落点。

keys: Flashes, then dashes. Hit it while it rests.
zh: 一闪就冲过来，趁它歇着的时候打。

keys: Keeps its distance and fires. Close in fast.
zh: 隔着距离开火，快点贴上去。

keys: Watch for the red "!" before each move.
zh: 每招之前都会冒红色的“!”，看准了再躲。

keys: A gear bug that crawls back and forth. One full shot breaks it.
zh: 沿地面来回爬的齿轮虫。蓄满一发就打碎。

keys: Always flies at the brightest thing: your lantern, your charge. Hit it as it pulls up.
zh: 总往最亮的东西飞：马灯、你蓄的光。它拉起来的时候打。

keys: Bolted down. Its steam won't hurt, but it pushes you off course.
zh: 钉死在地上。蒸汽不伤人，但会把你吹偏。

keys: Small and fast. After a slash it rests; that's your opening.
zh: 又小又快。砍完一刀会歇一下，那就是机会。

keys: Bounces at you. A red mark shows where it will land.
zh: 朝你弹过来，地上的红色标记是它的落点。

keys: Counts down, then fires a tin bird. Hit it while the door is open for double damage.
zh: 倒数完会射出一只铁皮鸟。小门开着的时候打它，伤害翻倍。

keys: Stitches the floor toward you and throws spools. Stitched ground slows you.
zh: 一路缝到你脚下，还会扔线轴。踩到缝线会变慢。

keys: Snaps its drawer and tosses coins. Drops an extra part.
zh: 猛拉钱箱咬人，还撒硬币。打倒了多掉一个零件。

keys: Plays the floor keys like a wave. Jump the wave, step off the chords.
zh: 把地板当琴键弹，一波一波压过来。跳过波浪，躲开和弦。

keys: Sucks in you, your shots and your lantern. Hit it 3 times to get the lantern back.
zh: 把你、光球和马灯都往嘴里吸。打它三下，马灯就掉回来。

keys: Charges until it hits a wall, then stays stunned. Punish it while it's dizzy.
zh: 一路冲到撞墙才停，撞完晕两秒，趁这时候狠狠打。

keys: Hangs from the ceiling and lunges down. Hit it while it reels back up.
zh: 挂在天花板上往下扑。趁它往回收的时候打。

keys: Explodes when it dies, shocking the floor and other enemies. Lure the crowd together.
zh: 死的时候会炸，电到地面和旁边的怪。把怪引到一块再打它。

keys: Plays dead, then rings for help. Take it out first.
zh: 先装死，再打铃叫帮手。先把它解决掉。

keys: Steals your lantern from the floor. Hit it twice to make it drop the lantern.
zh: 会捡走地上的马灯。打它两下，马灯就掉了。

keys: Aims a red line, then fires. Hit it while it aims to cancel the shot.
zh: 先瞄一道红线再开火。瞄准的时候打它，这一发就放不出来。

keys: Rolls along the floor and breaks on its second wall. Jump it or shoot it.
zh: 在地上滚，撞到第二面墙就散了。跳过去或者打掉。

keys: Sits still until one stands. Then the whole row pounces.
zh: 一动不动坐着，直到有一个站起来，然后整排扑过来。

keys: Sweeps a flashlight cone, then flashes. Step out of the cone.
zh: 手电筒扫来扫去，然后一闪。别站在光里。

keys: Whips its phone cord at waist height. Jump it or back off.
zh: 齐腰甩电话线。跳起来或者往后退。

keys: Electrifies the floor under you and calls fuse beetles. Shoot the plug to cut the power.
zh: 让你脚下的地板通电，还会叫保险丝甲虫。打插头就能断电。

keys: Its needle scratches along the floor. Jump over it.
zh: 唱针沿着地板划过来，跳过去。

keys: A hot spotlight sweeps the floor, then reels walk out of its picture.
zh: 滚烫的光柱扫地板，然后胶片盘从画面里走出来。

keys: Hooks you with a cord and reels you in. Dodge off the dotted line.
zh: 用电话线勾住你往回拽。躲开那条虚线。

keys: Charges with giant scissors and cuts to the spot behind you. Jump over the charge.
zh: 拿大剪刀冲过来，一剪就跳到你身后。跳过它的冲锋。

keys: A living giant that pounds the ground. The floor cracks where its fists land.
zh: 会捶地的活巨人。拳头落下的地方，地板会裂。

keys: Sends morse at you: dots are fast, dashes are slow. Read the code over its head.
zh: 朝你发电报：点快、划慢。看它头顶的电码。

keys: An old boiler that burns memories. It wants the tape in your lantern.
zh: 专烧回忆的老锅炉，想抢马灯里的录像带。

keys: A giant switchboard that kept every voice on the planet. It wants the family's voices.
zh: 收走了整颗星球声音的巨型交换台，想要录像里那家人的声音。

keys: The last TV that can still play the tape. It flips channels to fight.
zh: 最后一台还能放录像的老电视，靠换台出招。

keys: Pick one before level 1. Swap at the shop for 3 parts.
zh: 开局三选一，商店里花 3 个零件可以换。

keys: Hold, then release. Auto-aims and homes in a little.
zh:
按住蓄力，松手发射。
自动瞄准，还会稍微追踪。

keys: Tap to blast all around you. Best when surrounded.
zh:
按一下朝四周炸一圈。
被围住的时候最好用。

keys: 1 part a level, up to Lv3
zh: 每级 1 个零件，最多 3 级

keys: Damage x1 when calm, up to x2 in panic. Shots turn redder the angrier you get.
zh: 平静时伤害 x1，失控时 x2。越生气，打出去的东西越红。

keys: While the lantern sits on the ground, it fires a small orb at the nearest enemy within 150 each time you attack.
zh: 马灯放在地上时，你每出一招，灯就朝 150 以内最近的怪补一发小光球。

keys: Orb damage: Flash 40, Rivet 25 (every 4th rivet), Hammer 55.
zh: 小光球伤害：闪光灯 40、铆钉枪 25（每 4 颗补一发）、蒸汽锤 55。

keys: 0.3 s after each attack, it plays again from where you stand, at 50% damage.
zh: 每出一招，0.3 秒后在你现在的位置再放一次，伤害 50%。

keys: The Rivet Gun echoes every 3rd rivet. Echoes never echo.
zh: 铆钉枪每 3 颗回一次。回声不会再回声。

keys: The 10 notches under the lantern bar show your progress. More enemies, more healing.
zh: 马灯血条下面的 10 小格是进度。怪越多，回得越多。

keys: Per level: +0.35 s of rocket boot fuel.
zh: 每级：火箭靴油量 +0.35 秒。

keys: Base fuel is 1.0 s, or 0.7 s while you carry the lantern.
zh: 原本能喷 1.0 秒，提着马灯时 0.7 秒。

keys: Blocks one hit on the lantern every 20 / 15 / 10 s (Lv1 / Lv2 / Lv3).
zh: 每 20 / 15 / 10 秒（1 / 2 / 3 级）替马灯挡一次伤害。

keys: Per level: emotion rises 20% slower over time.
zh: 每级：情绪随时间上涨慢 20%。

keys: At Lv3 it climbs at 40% speed.
zh: 3 级时只按 40% 的速度涨。

keys: Play alone or together, then pick a level.
zh: 一个人玩或者一起玩，然后选关卡。
